tools.name: audit_ai_search_readiness
tools.description: Audit a public http/https URL for AI search readiness: robots.txt rules (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Googlebot), /llms.txt soft-404 detection, non-JS HTML title/description/canonical, JSON-LD schema types, and prioritized fix_first actions.

tools.name: compare_two_domains_readiness
tools.description: Run parallel deterministic non-JS AI search & SEO readiness probes on two public URLs (url_a vs url_b) and return a structured side-by-side gap table.
